create_fourrooms_env: create a FourRoomsEnv instance with optional agent and goal positions on a 19x19 grid
generate_fourrooms_grid: generate the four rooms gridworld layout with walls and random door positions between rooms
run_fourrooms_step: run a single step action in the FourRoomsEnv and return observation, reward, done, and info
register_fourrooms_gym: register the MiniGrid-FourRooms-v0 environment with the gym registry for use in training
place_agent_and_goal: place the agent and goal at specified or random positions within the four rooms environment
